title: Validation: problem
description: The problem sub-score (EE-026), at <venture>/purpose/validation/problem.json: the problem, who has it, how they cope today, and the cited evidence that it is real. A statement alone is the weakest form of this record; schema/check-validation.mjs grades it from its evidence.

statement.description: The problem in the words of the people who have it

segment.description: Who has it, specifically enough to find them

frequency.description: How often it happens to them

cost.description: What it costs them now: money, time, risk

workarounds.description: How they cope today; money or time already spent on a workaround is strong evidence

probability.description: The Jev probability that the problem is real and worth solving for this segment; the evidence grade weighs it in the validation score
